Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Mikal Bridges?

Mikal Bridges is 29 years old.

Where was Mikal Bridges born?

Mikal Bridges was born in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

When was Mikal Bridges born?

Mikal Bridges was born on August 30, 1996.

How tall is Mikal Bridges?

Mikal Bridges is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much does Mikal Bridges weigh?

Mikal Bridges weighs 209 lbs (94 kg).

Is Mikal Bridges in the Hall of Fame?

Mikal Bridges is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Mikal Bridges drafted?

Mikal Bridges was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (10th pick, 10th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Mikal Bridges play?

Small Forward and Shooting Guard.

What is Mikal Bridges' net worth?

Mikal Bridges has made at least $107,630,685 playing professional basketball.

How much does Mikal Bridges make?

Mikal Bridges made $24,900,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Mikal Bridges have?

Mikal Bridges has won one championship.

What is Mikal Bridges' Instagram account?

Mikal Bridges is on Instagram at mikalbridges.

What schools did Mikal Bridges attend?

Mikal Bridges attended Great Valley in Malvern, Pennsylvania and Villanova.

What are Mikal Bridges' nicknames?

The Warden, Noodles, Inspector Go Go Gadget, String Bean, Brittle, Praying Mantis, Brooklyn Bridges are nicknames for Mikal Bridges.
